panels.description:
Likely inaccurate accounts
  • "TM_POKE_S" (source) and "TM_POKE_T" (target) are just test accounts. The latter follows the other sources as well, but might have other increases/decreases based on personal manual trades used as tests.
  • bbox06 (101411): Had a notable bunch of old orders which came from before TradeManager. This implied a large initial exposure, so the account reached "max net lot" condition early in time and avoided some orders.
  • bbox11 (101183): Doesn't connect (error: invalid account). Well, now (2024-03-20) does.
  • bbox12 (101185): Same as "bbox06 (101411)" above.
  • bbox13 (101447): Formerly a netting account. Keep in mind: netting accounts group trades from resulting orders together by symbol and average open price. Therefore, the only ticket that remains valid in the order history is the first one of that symbol. As order-close operations are triggered by ticket number and most of them disappear from registry, the order counter never actually lowers down until all trades from such symbol are closed. Hence, such growth.
  • bbox14 (101972): Out of funds - not trading.
  • Checked all XMGlobal MT5 servers (from 1 to 11) and the error persists for XM accounts.

targets.rawSql:
WITH mults AS (  SELECT source, target, factor
    FROM tc_multipliers ORDER BY source, target
), leverages AS (  SELECT DISTINCT ON (alias)
        alias, leverage, round(balance / 100) / 10 AS b1000
        FROM tc_timeseries ORDER BY alias, timestamp DESC
), accounts_s AS (  SELECT alias AS alias_s,
        format('%s ("%s")', id, owner) AS id_s
    FROM tc_accounts WHERE (active = true)
        AND (category = 0)
), accounts_t AS (  SELECT alias AS alias_t,
        format('%s ("%s")', id, owner) AS id_t
    FROM tc_accounts WHERE (active = true)
        AND (category = 1)
), max_lots_net AS (  SELECT max_lots_net,
        format('%s ("%s")', id, owner) AS id_t
    FROM tc_accounts WHERE (active = true)
        AND (category = 1)
), mults_s AS (  SELECT * FROM mults INNER JOIN
    accounts_s ON mults.source = accounts_s.alias_s
), mults_t AS (  SELECT * FROM mults_s INNER JOIN
    accounts_t ON mults_s.target = accounts_t.alias_t
), merged AS ( SELECT * FROM leverages INNER JOIN
    accounts_t ON leverages.alias = accounts_t.alias_t
)

(SELECT id_s AS source, id_t AS target, factor FROM mults_t ORDER BY target) UNION ALL
(SELECT '*Leverage*' AS source, id_t as target, leverage FROM merged ORDER BY target) UNION ALL
(SELECT '*Bal (x1000)*' AS source, id_t as target, b1000 FROM merged ORDER BY target) UNION ALL
(SELECT '*Max net lot*' AS source, id_t as target, max_lots_net FROM max_lots_net ORDER BY target)

targets.rawSql:
SELECT metric, ts_resp as time,
  delay_trg AS "Executor :",
  delay_src AS "Receiver :",
  delay_zmq AS "ZMQ :"
FROM (  
  SELECT metric, ts_resp,
    AVG(t_resp - t_recv) AS delay_trg,
    AVG(t_recv - t_send) AS delay_zmq,
    AVG(t_send - t_sign) AS delay_src
  FROM (
    SELECT /*concat(action, ' : z=', nzmq::text, ' : ',
          SUBSTRING(comment, POSITION('c' IN comment))
        )*/ action AS metric, t_resp, t_recv, t_send, t_sign,
      TO_TIMESTAMP(t_resp / 1e6) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS ts_resp
    FROM tc_responses
    WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(t_resp / 1e6) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
      AND (success = true) /*AND (comment ~ 'c=')*/
  ) GROUP BY metric, ts_resp
) ORDER BY time

SELECT time, format('%s : CLOSE', symbol) AS metric, delay FROM (
  SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(t_exit_s / 1e6) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
  symbol, (t_exit - t_exit_s) AS delay FROM tc_trades_closed
) WHERE time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY time

SELECT time, format('%s : OPEN', symbol) AS metric, delay FROM (
  SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(t_entry_s / 1e6) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
  symbol, (t_entry - t_entry_s) AS delay FROM tc_trades_closed
) WHERE time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT server || ' : ' || symbol AS metric,
  abs(price_open - price_sign) AS price_diff,
  TO_TIMESTAMP(t_resp / 1e6) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time
FROM tc_responses
WHERE TO_TIMESTAMP(t_resp / 1e6) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND (order_type IN ('Buy', 'Sell')) AND (action ~ 'OPEN') AND (price_sign != 0)
ORDER BY time

SELECT time, format('%s : CLOSE', symbol) AS metric, slippage FROM (
  SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(t_exit_s / 1e6) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
  symbol, abs(p_exit - p_exit_s) AS slippage FROM tc_trades_closed
) WHERE time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY time

SELECT time, format('%s : OPEN', symbol) AS metric, slippage FROM (
  SELECT TO_TIMESTAMP(t_entry_s / 1e6) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AS time,
  symbol, abs(p_entry - p_entry_s) AS slippage FROM tc_trades_closed
) WHERE time BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo() ORDER BY time
